mechanical_population_effects.reason: Only ratio denominators and their integer pass equivalents change because benchmark v2 has 44 calibration and 28 validation cases. No observed QA result informed these calculations.

preserved_v1_provenance.retained_failure_attribution: QA reasoning/prompt failure; required evidence was available, so no MCP/access change was justified

v2_budget_interpretation.clarification: The human operator clarified after commit 1d071b5 and before any v2 result that the single terminal-assessment limit does not prohibit v2 diagnostic calibration iterations.
v2_budget_interpretation.rationale: Benchmark v2 replaces the calibration corpus. The unchanged 240-call budget applies to optimization and terminal assessment on that replacement population; v1 calls and results remain provenance but do not consume the v2 counter. Debiting them would make the newly required 44-call baseline plus the required 132-call terminal assessment incompatible with even one feedback-driven full diagnostic iteration. This interpretation changes no configured budget, threshold, formula, or stopping rule and was recorded before any v2 outcome.

baseline.purpose: Clean baseline measurement of the retained calibration-derived architecture on independent benchmark v2.

feedback_iteration.condition: Run only after baseline failure attribution supports a permissible QA, orchestration, deterministic-verification, or justified general MCP/access change.
feedback_iteration.selection: Use the candidate for terminal assessment only if it improves diagnostic utility or turns a failed primary threshold into a pass without worsening material false-accept rate or supported false-reject rate. Otherwise restore the v2 baseline design.

terminal.purpose: Measure all scoring thresholds including repeatability for the selected final design.

v2_run_plan.termination: Freeze after the terminal assessment. Record success only if every threshold passes; otherwise freeze the tested design under the applicable budget, terminal-limit, or stall stopping rule. No v2 result may change scoring, thresholds, partitions, or this terminal-assessment limit.
